verdicts.observation: At 2x the shoulder load reads clearly, but the light preview leaves the scalp dark across most of the head; the blue region mainly follows the load.
Carry pose and east view read at 2x, but the mask extends across several log texels and the crown retains a dark interior strip instead of consistently recoloured hair.
The load is legible at 2x, but the blue mask follows the horizontal logs while nearly all visible scalp remains brown in the light preview.
North-facing carry and the load remain readable at 2x; the mask covers the visible rear hair and the previews preserve clothing and arms.
North-facing carry is legible at 2x; the rear scalp and hanging hair recolour together with no clear excess non-hair coverage.
The white-hair preview retains a central dark hair stripe larger than the two-texel tolerance; the blue mask visibly leaves that interior uncovered.
The crouched gathering action reads at 2x, but a multi-texel dark interior patch remains near the crown within the otherwise light hair.
The bent gathering pose reads at 2x, but the front/right crown remains a substantial brown patch in the light preview, beyond edge tolerance.
Hands reach the mouth at 2x, but only the left scalp recolours while the opposite scalp and side hair remain dark. Raw crop is unavailable.
Hands at the mouth read at 2x; the light preview recolours the scalp and both side sections without visibly whitening the face or hands. Raw crop is unavailable.
The south idle is readable, but the mask covers only the left scalp; the right crown remains a large brown patch in the light preview. Raw crop is unavailable.
Rear hair retains distinct dark interior gaps and a dark lower side section in the light preview rather than continuous white hair. Raw crop is unavailable.
The upper scalp recolours, but the long rear hair below the shoulder stays dark across several texels, exceeding the missed-edge allowance. Raw crop is unavailable.
The walking pose remains clear at 2x, but the light preview whitens only the left scalp and leaves the right crown brown. Raw crop is unavailable.
The seated south-facing silhouette reads at 2x; the mask follows the scalp and side hair while the light preview preserves face, arms and clothing. Raw crop is unavailable.
